$comment: The titles of the quick fixes, each followed by " (not preferred)" when an editor must not offer it as the one to apply, and the links of the issues, which the corpus does not hold, read by FixesTest.kt. A case lists every issue of its source, sorted by start, end and code: its code, the text it marks and the titles of its fixes in the order offered, and its link where the case gives one. language is kotlin, html or expression.
